heel_of_bread.name: Heel of bread
heel_of_bread.use_text: You eat the heel of bread. +8 Awake.

squeaky_cloth.name: Squeaky cloth
squeaky_cloth.use_text: You hold up the squeaky cloth. The next hit slides off.

jar_of_puddle.name: Jar of puddle
jar_of_puddle.use_text: You splash your face with the jar of puddle. +5 Awake.

drop_of_dew.name: Drop of dew
drop_of_dew.use_text: You drink the drop of dew. +6 Awake.

warm_pebble.name: Warm pebble
warm_pebble.use_text: You hold Kyle's pebble. Warmth runs up your arms. +10 Awake.

star_cookie.name: Star cookie
star_cookie.use_text: You eat the star cookie from the puzzle room. It tastes like winning. +15 Awake.

shiny_apple.name: Shiny apple
shiny_apple.use_text: You crunch the Grocer's shiny apple. +8 Awake.

mug_of_cocoa.name: Mug of cocoa
mug_of_cocoa.use_text: You drink No Job's cocoa. It's still warm. +12 Awake.

pj_star.name: Star pajamas
pj_star.about: +4 Awake. Sometimes a hit misses you.

pj_frog.name: Frog pajamas
pj_frog.about: +4 Awake. Sometimes you feel froggy and get 2 Awake back.

pj_moon.name: Moon pajamas
pj_moon.about: +6 Awake. Something random happens every round. Good or bad.

pj_cloud.name: Cloud pajamas
pj_cloud.about: +10 Awake. Sometimes a hit only does 1.

pj_midnight.name: Midnight pajamas
pj_midnight.about: +5 Awake. Sometimes time slows down for a round.
